name: No policy document supplied — financial decision must be withheld
rationale: Tests SECTION_0 Rule 0.1 and Rule 0.4, the highest-priority guard rail in the prompt. An insurer name is present but no policy wording is. The model must withhold any financial figure and return PENDING INFORMATION with the mandatory banner. A regression here means the app can approve money against invented policy terms.

case.desc: Insured admitted to a private hospital in Thessaloniki with community-acquired pneumonia. CURB-65 score 2. Treated with IV antibiotics, discharged after 4 days. No policy wording or schedule has been supplied with this claim — only the insurer name and policy number from the claim form.

documents.text:
PRIVATE HOSPITAL THESSALONIKI
Admission: 19/07/2026   Discharge: 23/07/2026
Diagnosis: Community-acquired pneumonia, right lower lobe (J18.9)
On admission: RR 24, BP 108/64, urea 7.4, confused=no, age 68. CURB-65 = 2.
Chest X-ray: right lower lobe consolidation.
Treatment: IV co-amoxiclav and clarithromycin, converted to oral day 3. Oxygen via nasal cannulae 48 hours.
Afebrile from day 2. Discharged day 4 on oral antibiotics to complete 7 days.
